reviews.text: Great kennels and lovely people. Our Golden Reggie loved his stay and came out a happy pup. We would use again.

Absolutely shocking how my dog looked, hi lost 4kg in a week he looked dehydrated and poor looked after, I have to take my dog to the vet because he had diarrhoea with blood he is on antibiotics, and +€200 vet. At the start, the price was €175, on the collection of my dog went up €200. Will not recommend that kennel.
Very helpful great people great service and price would recommend 👍 …
My dogs had a great visit to Beechgrove Kennels.

My dog is actually excited to here.
I can't think of a better endorsement

Trevor,

Had to book in here as our usual kennel was booked out for the weekend. Terrible experience. When I picked my dog up after his  stay I was shocked at the condition he was in. He had a scratch on his nose. He smelled absolutely awful, so bad that it was tough to be in the car on the way back, and then when we bathed him we found poop stuck in his fur. He also seemed very dehydrated, which makes me question whether he even had regular access to clean water, as when he got home he made a beeline for the water bowl.  Will not be going back even if stuck
Great place to put your dog. Been using beechgrove for years and happy to keep going back. Highly recommended
Our dog is not a very easy character, but we finally found a place where he is accepted. The owner genuinely loves animals, and the dog feels that. I would certainly recommend the place!
Brilliant kennel. They take such good care of the dogs.
